notes: Chat and HUD: the HUD stays on in the drone and the scope again, drawn on top of the view; now without a plugin (250 bytes in the same exe as the chat, so the chat shows there too). Chat as in m10: lines at once as plain text, no boxes, dead players can chat. On Community Edition 2026.10.11-3; needs M3eptemp 3.22.20261016.
